format: traditional Wendy's Restaurant (new build, Franchise Agreement), all expenditures paid in cash, excluding real estate

invest.quote: excluding real estate, it normally ranges from $1,523,957 to $2,992,000 (excluding real property costs) if you purchase for cash, or from $393,191 - $752,000 (excluding real property costs) if you finance the initial technical assistance fee, building, and equipment (see Item 7). This includes an amount between $0 -$55,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: you must pay a Technical Assistance Fee of $50,000 for each Wendy's Restaurant at the time the Franchise Agreement is executed, or $12,500 for a Frosty Cart.
fee.note: Wendy's calls it a Technical Assistance Fee. New franchisees also pay a $5,000 Training Fee and $500 per background investigation. $25,000 generally for non-traditional sites and under the Franchise Flip program; $12,500 for a Frosty Cart; waived under Pacesetter agreements and possibly under New Groundbreaker agreements if opened early. Build-to-Suit/REPP add real estate service fees ($12,500, $17,500, $40,000) and a $35,000 Project Fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty Varies between 4-6% of "Gross Sales" (depending on the type of restaurant and development program): 4% for traditional/Groundbreaker Restaurants 5% for Restaurants developed under a previously executed Pacesetter Development Agreement 6% for Restaurants on military bases/Frosty Carts and those developed or acquired under the Build-to-Suit Program.

adFund.quote: National Advertising 1.50-3.50% of Gross Sales. ... Local and Regional Advertising .50% of Gross Sales.
adFund.note: Total 4% required Advertising Contribution (3.50% national WNAP + 0.50% local/regional); a co-op may vote a higher local rate (example given: 1.00% for a total of 4.50%). Frosty Cart national contribution is 1.5%. Development incentives temporarily reduce royalties and WNAP fees.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $6,620 - $15,000 per restaurant per year, paid quarterly, upon invoice (note: $7,620, $10,600 or $14,200 depending on prior-year Gross Sales; $14,200 if newly built)

otherRecurring.name: FreshAi Service Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $20,004 per restaurant per year, paid quarterly (monthly $1,667; restaurants opening on or after August 1, 2025)

otherRecurring.name: Cyber Insurance Policy Premium Payment
otherRecurring.amount: A per restaurant fee of approximately $889, subject to change annually, paid quarterly

otherRecurring.name: Customer Care
otherRecurring.amount: A per restaurant fee of $95 per month, paid quarterly

otherRecurring.name: In-App Delivery Account Settlement Services
otherRecurring.amount: A per-transaction fee of 3.0% of each in-app delivery transaction amount

rentToFranchisor: Only if you lease or sublease from Quality and/or its affiliates (rent 'Varies'). Under a Build-to-Suit Sublease, rent typically equals Wendy's head-lease rent (or a fixed market rent if Wendy's buys the land) plus a monthly percentage rent of gross sales set by CAPCOM (no percentage printed), plus a lease administration fee of at least $6,000 per year.

special: The initial fee is called a Technical Assistance Fee ($50,000). Investment excludes land; Item 7 notes purchasing land for company restaurants can cost an additional $500,000 - $1,500,000 (or more). Build-to-Suit restaurants pay a 6% royalty plus percentage rent to Wendy's. Technology Fee ($6,620 - $15,000/yr) and FreshAi Service Fee ($20,004/yr) are paid to the franchisor/affiliates in addition to royalty and advertising.
